notes:
Amarseba NID Verify 1.1.0 — full Windows desktop support and a session timer.

New
- Windows: the NID portal now loads reliably. The app detects and sets up the Edge WebView2 runtime and shows a clear Install / Retry screen instead of the old blank page.
- A session countdown appears after pairing (app and web), synced to server time, so you always know how long you have to finish.
- Desktop pairing is code-entry only — no camera needed.

Fixes & polish
- Deep links reuse the existing window instead of opening a new one each time.
- Cleaner verification header.
- Installer publisher/branding (Dhorola Amarseba Ltd) and automatic versioning.

Install
- Android 8.0+: amarseba-nid-verify.apk
- Windows 10/11 (64-bit): amarseba-nid-verify-setup.exe
